content:
Ben: prod alert — usw2-gpupool streaming tail latency spiking, lots of gRPC deadline_exceeded and token stalls starting ~09:12 UTC. Anyone seeing packet-related noise? :eyes:
Alice: seeing reordering counters climb on top-of-rack NICs in rack r12. Reorders -> retransmits -> stalled streams.
Carol: captured tcpdump from affected host, seq numbers jump out of order. small pcap attached to thread (will upload to S3).
Dan: kernel upgrade to 6.2 rolled last night in that AZ — could be path MTU/TSO/GRO changes. We've seen GRO interaction break RDMA/UDP before.
Erin: checked ethtool offloads on node-43: TSO=on GSO=on GRO=on. After toggling GRO off locally, observed immediate reduction in reorders on that host.
Frank: RDMA counters show packet-reorder errors (qp->rcv_rm_fifo) on mlx5. Also increased SQ retries. Likely asymmetric fragmentation on east-west path.
Ben: timeline: 6.2 kernel + NIC firmware 21.40 last rollout at 02:00. Need to confirm if firmware+kernel combo introduced segmentation differences.
Alice: quick test commands I ran:
```
# capture small window
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/reorder.pcap 'tcp and port 443'
sudo ethtool -k eth0
sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep -i reorder
```
Carol: traceroute + `ip route get` shows different egress via spine-2 for some hosts -> MTU on that path is 1500, others 9000. PMTU blackhole + offloads can reorder segments.
Dan: mitigation plan: 1) roll back kernel on a canary subset to 5.15, 2) disable GRO/TCP offloads on affected NICs cluster-wide temporarily, 3) bump streaming RPC deadline to 5s as short-term safety valve, 4) move high-QPS jobs away from r12 racks.
Erin: already flipped GRO off on 6 hosts in r12, tail latency dropped ~60% in those. Will schedule broader toggle during low traffic window.
Frank: ordering note: RDMA flows impacted more severely; for Dedicated pools we'll schedule NIC FW rollback if metrics continue.
monitor-bot: alerted 6 teams, created incident INC-2026-314.
Ben: solid. Also tweak autoscaler to keep 10% extra capacity during rollout so GPU tasks don't get evicted due to stalls.
Alice: adding packet captures and ethtool outputs to the incident doc. We should also check TOR configs for LRO/TSO passthrough.
Carol: follow-up: postmortem after incident resolution, include checklist: (a) kernel+firmware compatibility matrix, (b) automated offload toggles for quick mitigation, (c) per-rack MTU auditing.
Ben: thanks everyone. tagging SRE oncall for rollback coordination. :thumbsup:
